Why GPT-5.5 could use tools mid-task instead of stopping when it got stuck
The GPT-5.5 demo where OpenAI showed an AI carry a complex task alone
caption:
GPT-5.5 was the first model OpenAI built to actually carry a task all the way through, not just answer and stop.

Most AI gives you a response and waits. GPT-5.5 was designed differently: it sets a goal, picks up the right tools, checks what it produced, and keeps going if something is off. That shift made it feel less like a search engine and more like something actually working on your behalf.

This dropped a few months before GPT-5.6 Sol. Worth seeing where it started.
